Hi Elena —

Thanks again for a constructive discovery call earlier. Two quick notes and a suggested next step: 

1) It looks like the calendar invite we sent for the technical deep dive didn’t land on your side (no join link received). Sorry about that — I’m re-sending options below and will include a direct meeting URL and a fallback dial-in.

2) Short recap of where we landed on scope:
- Primary goal: prototype an inference flow for batch clinical summarization and near-real-time triage.
- Key non-negotiables: HIPAA-adjacent controls, <48h data retention policy, predictable 95th percentile latency targets.
- Success metric for the first POC: <150ms p95 on a 512-token window at 8 concurrent streams (target throughput TBD).

Proposed UTC-aware slots for the tech deep dive (please confirm your timezone — I saw you’re CET?):
- Tue Nov 17: 09:00–10:00 UTC / 10:00–11:00 CET
- Tue Nov 17: 15:00–16:00 UTC / 16:00–17:00 CET
- Wed Nov 18: 08:00–09:00 UTC / 09:00–10:00 CET

If none of those work, please propose 2 x 1-hour windows (with times and timezone) and I’ll lock one.

I attached the discovery notes from today and a short prep checklist for the deep dive. Agenda will be: quick recap (10m), architecture & constraints (20m), POC success criteria + rollout plan (20m), immediate next steps (10m).

Attachments: 20261113-discovery-notes.pdf (summary + data/traffic examples)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.
